class.name: Discord
class.brief_description: Discord Social SDK integration for RPC rich presence, OAuth, invites, and relationships.
class.description: The Discord singleton dynamically loads the Discord Partner SDK library at runtime. Use [method initialize_presence_only] for auth-less RPC rich presence, or [method initialize] for the full OAuth social layer (friends, invites, server auth). Pump [method run_callbacks] each frame (or rely on the engine frame hook) while the client is active.

method.name: accept_activity_invite
method.description: Accepts an activity invite built from [signal activity_invite_created] / [signal activity_invite_updated] payload fields. Requires OAuth ([constant AUTH_READY]).

method.name: accept_discord_friend_request
method.description: Accepts a pending Discord-wide friend request. OAuth only. Emits [signal relationship_action_completed].

method.name: accept_game_friend_request
method.description: Accepts a pending game-scoped friend request. OAuth only. Emits [signal relationship_action_completed].

method.name: authenticate_with_server
method.description: POSTs the OAuth access token to the auth server and returns the parsed response. Requires [constant AUTH_READY] and a non-empty access token.

method.name: block_user
method.description: Blocks a user. OAuth only. Emits [signal relationship_action_completed].

method.name: cancel_discord_friend_request
method.description: Cancels an outgoing Discord friend request. OAuth only.

method.name: cancel_game_friend_request
method.description: Cancels an outgoing game friend request. OAuth only.

method.name: clear_debug_log
method.description: Clears the in-memory debug log buffer.

method.name: clear_rich_presence
method.description: Clears the player's Discord rich presence. Requires presence readiness ([method is_ready_for_presence]).

method.name: create_or_join_lobby
method.description: Creates or joins a Discord lobby by secret. OAuth only. Emits [signal lobby_joined] on success.

method.name: get_access_token
method.description: Returns the OAuth access token obtained during [method initialize], or an empty string when not connected.

method.name: get_auth_state
method.description: Returns the current OAuth/auth lifecycle state.

method.name: get_connection_state
method.description: Returns the current Discord SDK connection state.

method.name: get_debug_log
method.description: Returns recent lifecycle and SDK log lines.

method.name: get_default_communication_scopes
method.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes for communication features.

method.name: get_default_presence_scopes
method.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes for rich presence and friends list.

method.name: get_game_activity
method.description: Returns the current user's game-associated activity readback, or an empty dictionary when unavailable.

method.name: get_granted_scopes
method.description: Returns the OAuth scopes granted by Discord after token exchange.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the most recent error message.

method.name: get_relationship
method.description: Returns a relationship dictionary for [param user_id], or empty when unavailable. OAuth only.

method.name: get_relationships
method.description: Returns all relationships as an array of dictionaries. OAuth only.

method.name: get_relationships_by_group
method.description: Returns relationships for a unified friends list group. OAuth only.

method.name: get_relationships_count
method.description: Returns the cached relationships count after [constant AUTH_READY], or [code]-1[/code] when unavailable.

method.name: get_requested_scopes
method.description: Returns the OAuth scopes requested during the current auth flow.

method.name: get_user
method.description: Returns a user dictionary for [param user_id]. OAuth only.

method.name: get_user_id
method.description: Returns the connected Discord user snowflake ID after [constant AUTH_READY], or [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_username
method.description: Returns the connected Discord display or username after [constant AUTH_READY].

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns SDK version metadata and runtime library availability.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the Discord Social SDK and starts the OAuth authorization flow.

method.name: initialize_presence_only
method.description: Initializes RPC rich presence without OAuth or [method initialize]'s connect step. Sets [method is_presence_only_mode] and emits [signal ready] immediately.

method.name: is_authorization_pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while waiting for OAuth ([constant AUTH_PENDING]).

method.name: is_authorized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after token exchange succeeds.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the Discord Partner SDK runtime library is present.

method.name: is_client_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the SDK client session is active.

method.name: is_debug_logging_enabled
method.description: Returns whether debug logging is enabled.

method.name: is_frame_hook_connected
method.description: Returns whether the engine frame hook is connected for automatic callback pumping.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method initialize] or [method initialize_presence_only].

method.name: is_presence_only_mode
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when initialized via [method initialize_presence_only] (RPC, no OAuth).

method.name: is_ready_for_presence
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when rich presence can be updated (RPC mode or [constant AUTH_READY]).

method.name: refresh_relationships
method.description: Refreshes the cached relationship count and emits [signal relationships_updated]. OAuth only.

method.name: register_launch_command
method.description: Registers a custom launch command for Discord deep links. Works in RPC and OAuth modes.

method.name: register_launch_steam_application
method.description: Registers Steam launch integration for Discord join flows. Works in RPC and OAuth modes.

method.name: reject_discord_friend_request
method.description: Rejects a pending Discord friend request. OAuth only.

method.name: reject_game_friend_request
method.description: Rejects a pending game friend request. OAuth only.

method.name: remove_discord_and_game_friend
method.description: Removes both Discord and game friendship. OAuth only.

method.name: remove_game_friend
method.description: Removes a game-scoped friend. OAuth only.

method.name: run_callbacks
method.description: Pumps Discord SDK callbacks. Also invoked automatically each frame when initialized.

method.name: send_activity_invite
method.description: Sends an activity invite with optional message text. OAuth only. Emits [signal activity_invite_sent].

method.name: send_activity_join_request
method.description: Sends a join request to another user. OAuth only.

method.name: send_activity_join_request_reply
method.description: Replies to an activity join request invite. OAuth only.

method.name: send_discord_friend_request
method.description: Sends a Discord-wide friend request by username. OAuth only.

method.name: send_discord_friend_request_by_id
method.description: Sends a Discord-wide friend request by user ID. OAuth only.

method.name: send_game_friend_request
method.description: Sends a game-scoped friend request by username. OAuth only.

method.name: send_game_friend_request_by_id
method.description: Sends a game-scoped friend request by user ID. OAuth only.

method.name: set_debug_logging
method.description: Enables verbose SDK file logging in user data.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the Discord SDK session and releases resources.

method.name: unblock_user
method.description: Unblocks a user. OAuth only.

method.name: update_rich_presence
method.description: Updates Discord rich presence. Keys include [code]type[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]details[/code], [code]state[/code], [code]details_url[/code], [code]state_url[/code], asset fields, [code]invite_cover_image[/code], [code]status_display_type[/code] ([code]name[/code]/[code]state[/code]/[code]details[/code]), [code]supported_platforms[/code] (array or bitmask), [code]party_id[/code], [code]party_current[/code], [code]party_max[/code], [code]join_secret[/code], [code]buttons[/code] ([code]{label,url}[/code]), and timestamps. Cached if called before ready.

signal.name: activity_invite_accepted
signal.description: Emitted when the local user accepts an activity invite.

signal.name: activity_invite_created
signal.description: Emitted when a new activity invite is received.

signal.name: activity_invite_updated
signal.description: Emitted when an existing activity invite is updated.

signal.name: activity_join_requested
signal.description: Emitted when another user requests to join via the Discord client Join button.

signal.name: authorization_started
signal.description: Emitted when OAuth authorization begins and the user must approve access.

signal.name: authorized
signal.description: Emitted when OAuth authorization succeeds before the client reaches ready state.

signal.name: connection_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the Discord client connection state changes.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Emitted when Discord is ready for rich presence updates.

signal.name: relationship_action_completed
signal.description: Emitted when an OAuth relationship action completes.

signal.name: relationship_created
signal.description: Emitted when a new relationship is created. OAuth only.

signal.name: relationship_deleted
signal.description: Emitted when a relationship is removed. OAuth only.

signal.name: relationship_groups_updated
signal.description: Emitted when unified friends list groups should be refreshed. OAuth only.

signal.name: relationships_updated
signal.description: Emitted when the relationship count is refreshed after connect.

signal.name: rich_presence_updated
signal.description: Emitted when a rich presence update completes.

signal.name: user_updated
signal.description: Emitted when a Discord user's profile or status changes. OAuth only.
